nodes.label: Confirm gate dedicated card UI (kind:"confirm")
nodes.rationale: High-risk tool confirmations need a distinct two-button confirm card (no textarea, tone-notice color) instead of the generic free-text question panel, so risk severity is visually unambiguous regardless of the acting role.

nodes.label: Exclude high-risk finance tools from ALLOWED_TOOLS to actually trigger confirm gate
nodes.rationale: canUseTool is only invoked by the SDK for tools absent from ALLOWED_TOOLS; keeping high-risk finance tools (e.g. calculate_payroll_batch, export_kingdee_draft) in that list silently bypassed the risk-confirm hook regardless of the UI card existing.

nodes.label: json_patch atomic UPDATE for artifact state
nodes.rationale: Read-modify-write of artifact JSON state let concurrent checklist-item toggles silently overwrite each other's snapshot; a single SQL UPDATE using json_patch(state, json_object(...)) makes each item update atomic without needing an application-level lock.

nodes.community_name: json_patch atomic UPDATE for artifact state

nodes.label: fact_* tables migration (fact_invoices/fact_payroll/fact_metrics/fact_obligations) replacing legacy tables

nodes.label: Embedding model self-download + async spawn + model-column filtering for semantic search
